final: WITH sex_averages AS (SELECT p.SEX, AVG(1.0 * l.CPK / NULLIF(l.GPT, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE p.SEX IS NOT NULL AND p.SEX <> '' AND l.CPK IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT IS NOT NULL AND l.GPT <> 0 GROUP BY p.SEX), first_pass AS (SELECT SEX, avg_ratio, AVG(avg_ratio) OVER () AS first_mean FROM sex_averages), second_pass AS (SELECT SEX, avg_ratio, first_mean FROM first_pass WHERE avg_ratio > first_mean), second_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS value FROM second_pass), remaining AS (SELECT s.avg_ratio, s.first_mean, m.value AS second_mean FROM second_pass AS s CROSS JOIN second_mean AS m WHERE s.avg_ratio > m.value) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS average_remaining_group_ratio_averages, AVG(avg_ratio - first_mean) AS average_excess_over_first_mean, AVG(avg_ratio - second_mean) AS average_excess_over_second_mean FROM remaining
